_comment: Seed of credible ALTERNATE suppliers per material. Listed ones are benchmarked live via Munshot; private ones via Probe42 (gated). 'verify' CINs must be confirmed on MCA before any paid call. secondSourceFor flags candidates to de-risk a single-source material.

dextrose.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
dextrose.fitNote: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji.

dextrose.name: Sanstar Ltd
dextrose.fitNote: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose) — growing capacity.

dextrose.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
dextrose.fitNote: Indian arm of global starch major Roquette — pharma-grade dextrose/excipients; premium, very reliable.

dextrose.name: Ingredion India Pvt Ltd
dextrose.fitNote: Global ingredients major; pharma & food dextrose; strong quality systems.

dextrose.name: Angel Starch & Food Pvt Ltd
dextrose.fitNote: South-India maize starch/dextrose maker; regional logistics advantage.

packaging.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
packaging.fitNote: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong, profitable — a robust alternate for bottles/closures.

packaging.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
packaging.fitNote: Listed moulded & blow-moulded packaging; broad capability across bottles/caps.

packaging.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
packaging.fitNote: Listed PET bottle/jar specialist (Pearlpet) — direct fit for PET bottles.

packaging.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
packaging.fitNote: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms. Top second-source candidate.

laminates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Listed flexible-packaging converter (already a tiny FDC supplier) — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

laminates.name: UFLEX Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Listed flexibles giant — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source GEEP at scale.

laminates.name: Ester Industries Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Listed BOPET film maker — substrate supply, not finished laminate; use for film cost benchmarking.

laminates.name: Cosmo First Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Listed BOPP/specialty film maker — substrate, not conversion.

laminates.name: Polyplex Corporation Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Listed PET film major — substrate benchmark.

laminates.name: Jindal Poly Films Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Listed BOPET/BOPP film major — substrate benchmark.

laminates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Global Constantia group's India converter — pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source for GEEP.

laminates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
laminates.fitNote: Global Amcor's India arm — high-end pharma laminates; premium but very reliable.

laminates.name: Paharpur 3P (Positive Packaging)
laminates.fitNote: Large Indian flexible-packaging converter — sachet & pouch laminates.
